# Recommended Outdoor Experiences

### Stroll Through Parks & Gardens
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
Enjoy the serene beauty and shaded paths of Paris's iconic green spaces. Perfect for a morning walk or a relaxed afternoon picnic.

### Seine River Cruise
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/water.svg
Experience Paris from a unique perspective with a refreshing breeze on the water. A great option for midday sightseeing or a romantic evening.
- **Key Activity:** Daytime or evening boat tours passing major landmarks.
- **Comfort Tip:** The gentle movement and open air provide a cooling effect.
Action: [Button: Book a River Cruise] https://www.bateauxparisiens.com/en/

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
Wander through charming neighborhoods like Le Marais or Saint-Germain-des-Prés, discovering boutiques, cafes, and historical architecture.

- **Comfort Tip:** Pop into air-conditioned shops or cafes if you need a break from the sun.
Action: [Button: Discover Le Marais] https://en.parisinfo.com/what-to-see-in-paris/the-districts-of-paris/le-marais
